_meta.title: The Automation Dialectic
_meta.subtitle: A Fractal Critique
_meta.description: Each level contains the same oscillation between position and counter-position, but at different scales.

panels.title: Automation Takes Away Autonomy
narrative: Every automated system removes a choice.
The algorithm recommends, the interface constrains.
What was once deliberate becomes default.

qfep.description: Pure order: the system predicts and you conform

panels.title: Cognitive Offloading is Liberation
panels.position: We WANT to delegate. Slave to the rhythm.
narrative: The tool carries so we can travel further.
Automation frees cognition for other things.

qfep.description: Entropy as freedom: the system handles the predictable, you handle the unpredictable

panels.title: Opting Out is a Privilege
panels.position: Not everyone can choose their tools.
narrative: The factory worker uses what's provided.
The precarious worker uses what's available.

code.block:
# The condition of entry
if not user.has_tool(required_tool):
    access.deny()
    
# No alternative offered
var choice = null  # There is no choice

qfep.description: The order is not chosen, it is given. λ is set by others.

panels.title: At Every Level There is a λ to Adjust
panels.position: Even within constraints, there are dials.
narrative: How much do I let the autocomplete write?
When do I override the recommendation?
Which defaults do I accept, which do I change?
The dial exists. The question is: can you reach it?

code.block:
# The dials exist
var lambda = 0.5  # How much entropy do you allow?

# You can adjust (if you know how)
autocomplete.enabled = user_preference
recommendation.weight = slider.value

# Small freedoms within constraints
for setting in accessible_settings:
    adjust(setting)

qfep.description: The entropy drive: how much chaos/freedom does the system permit?

panels.title: Who Actually Has Access to the Dials?
narrative: The defaults are someone else's decision.

code.block:
# What you see
var visible_settings = [
    "dark_mode",
    "notifications",
    "language"
]

# What exists
var all_settings = config.get_all()  # 10,000 keys

# The ratio
var your_control = visible_settings.size() / all_settings.size()
# = 0.0003 = 0.03%

qfep.description: The order you can't see. The λ you can't touch.

panels.title: We Can Make the Dials Visible
panels.position: Open source. Inspect element. Read the code.
narrative: Teach the structure, not just the interface.
Show the parameters that shape behavior.
This is what Ada Research does.

qfep.description: Making the order visible. Making the entropy dial accessible.

panels.title: Not Everyone Can Read Code
narrative: The hacker solution requires resources not everyone has.

qfep.description: The dial exists but hands are bound.

panels.title: We Don't Have to Do It Alone
narrative: Those who can read share with those who can't.

qfep.description: The entropy dial is turned together.

panels.title: The Dialectic Never Resolves
panels.position: Each answer generates its own question.
narrative: This is the structure of thinking.
That says 'this is just how it is'
Knowing which is which: that's the work.

qfep.description: Positive φ: embracing the change itself. The becoming, not the being.
